column1: # comment: "GMEOW term to Wikidata Q-item alignments (concept-scheme layer; QIDs validated)."

column7: comment
Wikidata 'agent' is a very abstract philosophical concept; GMEOW Agent is the actor in provenance and trust assertions. Directional lossy projection.
Wikidata 'social group' is broader than GMEOW Group (which includes non-social collectives). Directional lossy projection.
Wikidata 'mailbox' is primarily physical; GMEOW Mailbox covers both physical and electronic. Directional lossy projection.
Wikidata 'media file' is broader than GMEOW MediaObject (which includes non-file media); directional lossy projection
Wikidata 'graduation ceremony' is narrower than GMEOW eventTypeGraduation (which covers any educational completion); directional lossy projection
ex:lexCat is the English noun lexeme 'cat'; wd:L7 is the Wikidata lexeme cat (English, noun, lexical category Q1084). The example is a minimal illustrative lexeme, so closeMatch, not identity.
ex:lexChase is the English verb lexeme 'chase'; wd:L14462 is the Wikidata lexeme chase (English, verb, lexical category Q24905). A minimal illustrative lexeme, so closeMatch.
ex:lexMouse is the English noun lexeme 'mouse'; wd:L1119 is the Wikidata lexeme mouse (English, noun, lexical category Q1084). A minimal illustrative lexeme, so closeMatch.

column4: cat sense: domesticated feline kept as a house pet
column7: ex:senseCat is the animal sense of the lexeme 'cat'; wd:L7-S1 is the Wikidata sense 'domesticated subspecies of feline animal, commonly kept as a house pet'. A GMEOW sense carries contexts a Wikidata sense flattens, so closeMatch.
ex:senseChase is the pursuit sense of the lexeme 'chase'; wd:L14462-S2 is the Wikidata sense 'follow, pursue'. closeMatch, not identity.

column4: mouse sense: any small rodent of the genus Mus
column7: ex:senseMouse is the rodent sense of the lexeme 'mouse'; wd:L1119-S1 is the Wikidata sense 'any small rodent of the genus Mus'. closeMatch, not identity.
Wikidata P424 is the Wikimedia language code; GMEOW languageCode uses BCP-47. Related but not identical.
lang:CommunicativeAct records what a use of a form does; wd:Q25481968 (speech act — an utterance that serves a performative function) is the same notion. A concept-scoped match, so skos:closeMatch.
lang:CommunicativeForce is the illocutionary force of a communicative act; wd:Q1599204 (illocutionary act, coined by J. L. Austin) is the same category. A concept-scoped match, so skos:closeMatch.

lang:CompositionRule is a rule of the compositional program building a composed denotation from its constituents; wd:Q936559 (principle of compositionality) is the principle it realizes. A concept-scoped match, so skos:closeMatch.

The Montagovian program (wd:Q3272938, Montague grammar) is the compositional-semantics framework lang:CompositionRule draws its fragment from. A related framework rather than identity, so skos:relatedMatch.
lang:Denotation is the reified record of what a form means; wd:Q1189753 (denotation — the literal meaning of a sign) is the semiotic notion GMEOW reifies. A concept-scoped match, so skos:closeMatch.

lang:IndexicalAnchor is the deictic centre an interpretation act resolves indexicals against; wd:Q340015 (deixis) is the phenomenon it anchors. A related notion rather than identity, so skos:relatedMatch.

lang:Orthography is the sign-system→script writing convention (which script a sign system is written in, through lang:orthographyFor + lang:usesScript); wd:Q43091 (orthography) is Wikidata's class for the conventions of writing a language. A close match to the convention concept, distinct from the bare repertoire lang:Script.

lang:Script is a first-class character repertoire (a script); wd:Q8192 (writing system) is Wikidata's class for a system of visual signs for writing. GMEOW distinguishes the bare repertoire (lang:Script) from the orthographic convention (lang:Orthography), so the match to the broader Wikidata class is close, not exact.
lang:Sense is a lexicalized way of meaning; wd:Q1570700 (word sense — one of the meanings of a word) is the same notion at the lexical level. A concept-scoped match, so skos:closeMatch.

lang:corefersWith links two referring expressions naming one discourse referent; wd:Q63087 (coreference — when two or more expressions refer to the same thing) is the same relation. A concept-scoped match, so skos:closeMatch.
lang:english is the English natural language; wd:Q1860 (English) is the same language. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
lang:featCase is the Case feature key; wd:Q128234 (case) is the linguistic category — categorization of nouns and modifiers by function. A concept-scoped match, so skos:closeMatch.
lang:featNumber is the Number feature key; wd:Q104083 (grammatical number) is the linguistic category. A concept-scoped match to the feature-inventory key, so skos:closeMatch.
lang:featTense is the Tense feature key; wd:Q177691 (tense) is the linguistic category locating a situation in time. A concept-scoped match, so skos:closeMatch.
lang:latinScript is the Latin script; wd:Q8229 (Latin script) is the same character repertoire. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
lang:noun is the noun part of speech; wd:Q1084 (noun) is the same category. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

lang:presupposes relates a form to the content it presupposes; wd:Q1076131 (presupposition — assumed context surrounding an utterance) is the phenomenon. A related notion (a property vs a concept), so skos:relatedMatch.
lang:verb is the verb part of speech; wd:Q24905 (verb) is the same category. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:AbelianGroup is a group with a commutative operation; wd:Q181296 (abelian group) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:ActivationFunction is the elementwise nonlinearity of a neural layer; wd:Q4677469 (activation function) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:AlgebraicStructure is a set equipped with operations satisfying axioms; wd:Q205464 (algebraic structure) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:Automorphism is an isomorphism of a structure with itself; wd:Q782566 (automorphism) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:AutomorphismGroup is the group of a structure's automorphisms — its symmetry group; wd:Q60790315 (automorphism group) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:BayesianNetwork is a DAG of random variables with conditional probability tables; wd:Q812540 (Bayesian network) is the same probabilistic graphical model. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:BilinearForm is a map linear in each argument; wd:Q837924 (bilinear form) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:BoundaryAtInfinity is the boundary — the set of ideal points — a compactification adjoins at infinity; wd:Q1191139 (point at infinity) is the 'limiting point in some geometric spaces' such a boundary collects. closeMatch, not identity: the GMEOW term is the boundary set of ideal points, a close but non-invertible (set-versus-point) counterpart of the individual point-at-infinity concept.
math:CartanMatrix is the integer matrix of Cartan integers of a root system's simple roots; wd:Q2004951 (Cartan matrix) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:Cell is a single graded cell of a cell complex; wd:Q189061 (CW complex, 'type of topological space' built by attaching cells) is the complex a cell is a constituent of. A part-of-the-whole relation, not a near-identity, so skos:relatedMatch; QID verified via the Wikidata search API. (No dedicated Wikidata item exists for a single CW-complex cell as distinct from the complex it builds — checked via wbsearchentities and the enwiki 'Cell (mathematics)' → 'Face (geometry)#Cell or 3-face' redirect, neither a clean match — so the target stays the complex-level QID.)

math:CellIncidence reifies one signed entry of the boundary (incidence) matrix — a coface, a codimension-1 face, and the ±1 orientation sign; wd:Q939272 (incidence matrix, 'matrix that shows the relationship between two classes of objects') is the whole matrix. A single signed entry vs the whole matrix is a part-of-the-whole relation, not a near-identity, so skos:relatedMatch; QID verified via the Wikidata search API.

math:CliffordAlgebra is the unital associative algebra generated from a quadratic space by the Clifford relation; wd:Q674689 names that same algebraic construction. Identity is exact, while GMEOW additionally requires an explicit field, signature, basis, grading, involutions, dimension, and product witnesses.

math:ClosedFormFunction is a function given by an explicit closed-form expression in one formal argument; wd:Q777407 (closed-form expression, 'mathematical formula built with arithmetic operations and other previously defined functions') names the closed-form expression concept the function's body IS. closeMatch, not identity: the GMEOW class is the function abstracted over that expression (carrying its formal argument, parameters, domain, and codomain), a close but non-invertible counterpart of the bare expression concept. QID curl-validated July 2026.

math:CochainComplex is the dual graded sequence with degree-raising coboundary maps whose square is zero; wd:Q78271410 (cochain complex, 'chain complex with the grading reversed') is defined identically. Class-to-class identity, so skos:exactMatch; QID verified via the Wikidata search API.

math:Cocycle is a cochain in the kernel of the coboundary (a closed cochain, δc = 0); wd:Q5139921 (cocycle, 'cochain that is closed') is defined identically. A single closed cochain vs the general concept, so skos:closeMatch; QID verified via the Wikidata search API.

math:CombinatorialLaplacian is the degree-k combinatorial (graph/cell) Laplacian L_k = ∂_{k+1}∘∂_{k+1}* + ∂_k*∘∂_k built from a cell complex's signed boundary operators; wd:Q772067 (Laplacian matrix, 'matrix representation of a graph', L = D − A) names the graph-specific degree-0 case of the same construction. relatedMatch, not closeMatch: the gmeow object GENERALISES the Wikidata item to every degree k of an arbitrary math:CellComplex, not just the vertex-degree graph case, and commits to the explicit math:combinatorialLaplacianComplex / math:laplacianDegree / math:upperBoundaryOperator / math:lowerBoundaryOperator frame that the Wikidata item's plain D−A matrix does not name — a generalization relation, not a near-identity. QID verified via the Wikidata API (Laplacian matrix sitelink).
math:CommutativeRing is a ring whose multiplication commutes; wd:Q858656 (commutative ring) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:CompactSpace is a space where every open cover has a finite subcover; wd:Q381892 (compact space) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:Compactification is the structured four-role record of embedding an unbounded space in a bounded one; wd:Q546145 (compactification) is the same concept — 'embedding a topological space into a compact space as a dense subset'. closeMatch, not identity: the GMEOW term is a structured record naming its four roles, a close but non-invertible counterpart of the bare Wikidata concept.
math:ComplexManifold is a manifold with holomorphic transition maps; wd:Q578874 (complex manifold) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:ConditionalProbability P(A|B) names both event and conditioning context; wd:Q327069 (conditional probability) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:ConformalCompactification is the general Penrose-style conformal compactification carrying a conformal factor; wd:Q864015 (Penrose diagram) is the two-dimensional diagram OF such a compactification of spacetime, capturing its causal relations — a related but non-identical concept (a diagram/reading, not the compactification map itself), and Wikidata has no dedicated 'conformal compactification' entity, so skos:relatedMatch.
math:ConnectedSpace is a space not the disjoint union of two non-empty open sets; wd:Q1491995 (connected space) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:Connection is a rule of parallel transport; wd:Q31924 (connection, 'geometrical idea of transporting data along a curve or family of curves in a parallel and consistent manner') names the same concept. closeMatch, not exactMatch: the gmeow object additionally commits to the PRIMARY discrete sheaf-connection reading (math:connectionOfSheaf over a math:CellularSheaf) and the math:connectionOn frame, a close but not invertibly identical counterpart. QID verified via the Wikidata API (Connection (mathematics) sitelink).

math:ContinuousMap is a continuous map of topological spaces; wd:Q170058 (continuous function, 'preimage of an open set is open') is the same notion phrased as a function. closeMatch (map vs function framing).
math:CountingMeasure assigns to a set the number of its elements; wd:Q247204 (counting measure) is the same measure. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:CrossEntropy and wd:Q1685498 both name the expected negative log-likelihood of one probability distribution under another distribution's coding model. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:Derivative is the instantaneous rate of change d/dx; wd:Q29175 (derivative, mathematics) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch (the QID disambiguates the financial and chemistry senses).

math:Dimensionless is the identity of the dimension vector space (zero vector); wd:Q126818 (dimensionless quantity) is the close counterpart (a quantity of that dimension rather than the dimension itself). closeMatch.

math:Distance is the general norm-induced metric distance; wd:Q847073 (Euclidean distance) is the specific ℓ₂ instance. closeMatch: the general metric distance and the Euclidean special case are close but non-invertible counterparts.
math:Distribution is a law assigning probabilities over outcomes; wd:Q200726 (probability distribution) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:DynkinDiagram is the graph classifying a root system's simple roots; wd:Q5319218 (Dynkin diagram) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:Eigendecomposition factors an operator into its eigenvalue/eigenvector pairs; wd:Q190524 (eigenvectors and eigenvalues) names the underlying concept. The decomposition object is a facet of that concept, so skos:closeMatch.

math:EncryptionScheme is the scheme (key + encrypt/decrypt maps); wd:Q141090 (encryption) names the process. closeMatch, not identity: the scheme and the process are close but non-invertible counterparts.

math:Entropy is explicitly the information-theoretic entropy of a probability distribution; wd:Q204570 names that same information entropy rather than thermodynamic entropy. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:ExtendedRealLine is the signed extended real line ℝ̄ = ℝ ∪ {−∞, +∞}; wd:Q1416516 (extended real number line) names the same two-point compactification concept. closeMatch, not identity: the GMEOW term is a system individual carrying the adjunction machinery (its poles and subsystem edges), a close but non-invertible counterpart of the bare Wikidata concept — the same rung the finite number systems take.
math:ExteriorAlgebra and wd:Q1196652 both name the Grassmann exterior algebra generated by a vector space under the alternating exterior product. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:FactorGraph is a bipartite graph representing the factorization of a joint distribution; wd:Q5428725 (factor graph) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:Field is a commutative ring whose non-zero elements form a multiplicative group; wd:Q190109 (field) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:FisherInformation and wd:Q1420659 both name the information an observable random variable carries about an unknown distribution parameter. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:GlobalSection is a section over the ENTIRE base of a sheaf, an element of H⁰; wd:Q91783823 (global section, aliased 'section of a sheaf') names the same object. Class-to-class identity, so skos:exactMatch; QID verified via the Wikidata search API.

math:GluingObstruction is the H¹ class recording why local sections may FAIL to satisfy the gluing axiom and lift to a global section; wd:Q5572389 (gluing axiom, 'property defining a sheaf') is the axiom it obstructs. The obstruction-to vs the axiom-itself, so skos:relatedMatch; QID verified via the Wikidata search API.

math:GramMatrix is the symmetric matrix of inner products of a set of vectors (the matrix of a symmetric bilinear form in a basis); wd:Q1409400 (Gramian matrix) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:Group is a monoid in which every element has an inverse; wd:Q83478 (group) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:GroupAction is the action of a group on a set compatible with the group operation; wd:Q288465 (group action) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:GroupHomomorphism preserves the group operation; wd:Q868169 (group homomorphism) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:GroupRepresentation is a homomorphism of a group into a general linear group; wd:Q1055807 (group representation) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:Holonomy is the parallel transport around a CLOSED loop whose deviation from the identity is the curvature witness; wd:Q907926 (holonomy, 'concept in differential geometry') names the same concept. closeMatch, not exactMatch: the gmeow object commits to the explicit math:holonomyLoop / math:holonomyOf frame and the discrete restriction-map-composite reading, a close but not invertibly identical counterpart. QID verified via the Wikidata search API.

math:Homeomorphism is a continuous bijection with continuous inverse; wd:Q202906 (homeomorphism) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch. Distinct from a homomorphism (curl-verified sense to avoid the homeo/homo confusable).

math:HomologyGroup is the n-th homology group Hₙ(X); wd:Q1144780 (homology, 'associating a sequence of algebraic objects') is the theory it belongs to. closeMatch (a group in the sequence vs the theory); curl-verified distinct from homotopy.
math:HomomorphicEncryptionScheme is a scheme allowing computation on ciphertexts; wd:Q2154943 (homomorphic encryption) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:Homomorphism is a structure-preserving map between algebraic structures; wd:Q215111 (homomorphism) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:Homotopy is a continuous deformation between two continuous maps; wd:Q746083 (homotopy) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch (curl-verified to distinguish from homology Q1144780).
math:Ideal is an additive subgroup of a ring closed under multiplication by any ring element; wd:Q44649 (ideal, ring theory) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:InnerProductSpace is a vector space with an inner product; wd:Q214159 (inner product space) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:Integral is the first-class integral object ∫ f dμ; wd:Q80091 (integral) is the same operation of calculus. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:Interval is the ordered real interval { x ∈ ℝ̄ | lower ⋚ x ⋚ upper }; wd:Q185148 (interval, 'subset of an ordered set consisting of all elements between two given endpoints') names the same order-theoretic concept. closeMatch, not identity: the GMEOW class is the specialization over the extended real line carrying its endpoints and both endpoint inclusions, a close but non-invertible counterpart of the general ordered-set concept.
math:Isomorphism is an invertible structure-preserving map; wd:Q189112 (isomorphism) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:KnowledgeGraphEmbedding maps a graph into a latent space; wd:Q33003557 (knowledge graph embedding) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:KullbackLeiblerDivergence and wd:Q255166 both name the directed information divergence from a reference probability distribution to a comparison distribution. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:Lattice is a discrete subgroup of a real vector space that spans it; wd:Q1096885 (lattice, the discrete-subgroup sense) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:LatticeHardnessAssumption is the hardness assumption a scheme rests on; wd:Q6497083 (lattice-based cryptography) names the cryptographic family built on such assumptions. closeMatch: the assumption and the family that uses it are close but non-invertible counterparts.
math:LebesgueMeasure is the translation-invariant length/area/volume measure on ℝⁿ; wd:Q827230 (Lebesgue measure) is the same measure. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:LieAlgebra is the infinitesimal structure of a Lie group — a vector space with an alternating bracket; wd:Q664495 (Lie algebra) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:LieGroup is a group that is also a smooth manifold; wd:Q622679 (Lie group) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:Limit is a limit binding expression; wd:Q33540 (limit of a function) is the analysis concept it most directly realizes. closeMatch — the GMEOW class also covers limits of sequences.

math:LimitResult is the structured evaluated result of a limit — its outcome and value — not the limit concept itself; wd:Q33540 (limit of a function) is the concept it records the outcome of, a related resource rather than its identity (math:Limit already closeMatches Q33540), so skos:relatedMatch.
math:LinearMap is a structure-preserving map between vector spaces; wd:Q207643 (linear map) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:LorentzianManifold is the signature-(1,n−1) case; wd:Q1510587 (pseudo-Riemannian manifold) is the general indefinite-metric superconcept. closeMatch — Lorentzian is the distinguished pseudo-Riemannian signature spacetime uses.
math:LossFunction is the objective a training problem minimizes; wd:Q1036748 (loss function) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:Manifold is a space locally homeomorphic to ℝⁿ; wd:Q2721559 (topological manifold) is the base case. closeMatch — the GMEOW class also parents the smooth/complex/Riemannian/Lorentzian refinements.
math:MarkovKernel is a measurable map assigning to each source point a probability measure on a target space; wd:Q6771323 (Markov kernel) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:Matrix is a rectangular array of scalars representing a linear map or form in a basis; wd:Q44337 (matrix) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:MeasurableFunction is a function under which the preimage of every measurable set is measurable; wd:Q516776 (measurable function) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:MeasurableSet is an element of the σ-algebra of a measurable space — one measurable subset, the kind of subset a measure can weigh; wd:Q3054889 (measurable set, 'an element of the sigma-algebra of a measurable space') is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:MeasurableSpace is a set with a σ-algebra; wd:Q3058218 (measurable space) is the same pairing on which a measure can be defined. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:Measure is the measure-theory measure — a countably-additive assignment of non-negative extended-real mass; wd:Q192276 (measure) is the same concept, a generalization of length, area, volume, and integral. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:MetricTensor is a symmetric (0,2) tensor field giving lengths and angles; wd:Q757269 (metric tensor) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:Module is an abelian group with a compatible ring-scalar action; wd:Q18848 (module) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:Monoid is a semigroup with an identity element; wd:Q208237 (monoid) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:MonotonicityKind is the vocabulary classifying a function's monotonic behaviour (strictly increasing/decreasing, non-increasing/decreasing, constant); wd:Q194404 (monotonic function) is the function that preserves or reverses the order. Classifier to function-concept, so skos:closeMatch.
math:Morphism is a structure-preserving map between objects; wd:Q1948412 (morphism) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:MultiparameterFiltration is a filtration indexed by a poset of dimension ≥ 2; wd:Q59442784 (Computing Multidimensional Persistence, Carlsson–Singh–Zomorodian) is the defining scholarly article of the multidimensional/multiparameter persistence line, which established that there is no complete discrete invariant (math:multiparameterInvariantBoundary). The object aligned to its defining reference, so skos:relatedMatch, not identity — no distinct concept item exists. QID verified via the Wikidata search API.
math:MutualInformation and wd:Q252973 both name the information-theoretic measure of dependence between two random variables. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:OptimizationProblem is a single minimize-objective-subject-to-constraints specification; wd:Q141495 (mathematical optimization) names the field/activity. The problem is an instance of that concept, so skos:closeMatch.
math:OrthogonalComplement is S-perp within an inner-product space; wd:Q1780921 (orthogonal complement) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:PCAAnalysis is the principal-component analysis; wd:Q2873 (principal component analysis) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:ParallelTransport is the transport of a fibre element along a DECLARED path under a connection; wd:Q1814838 (parallel transport, 'a map between two fibres of a fibre bundle induced by a path ... and a connection in the fibre bundle') names the same concept. closeMatch, not exactMatch: the gmeow object commits to the math:transportConnection / math:transportAlong frame and, for the discrete reading, to a COMPOSITION of math:SheafRestrictionMaps, a close but not invertibly identical counterpart. QID verified via the Wikidata search API.

math:PersistenceModule is the algebraic functor P: (index poset) → Vect a persistence computation decomposes; wd:Q117101306 (Persistence module) names the same concept. closeMatch, not exactMatch: the gmeow object additionally commits to the math:Functor typing and the math:moduleIndex/math:structureMap frame, a close but not invertibly identical counterpart. QID verified via the Wikidata search API.

math:PersistentHomology is the method that computes topological features across the scales of a filtration; wd:Q17099562 (persistent homology) names that same method. Concept identity is exact, while the generated Wikidata view remains a sound under-approximation because it does not carry GMEOW's filtration, result, and law-bearing frame.

math:PiecewiseFunction is a function defined by pieces, each a sub-behaviour over its own interval; wd:Q2037833 (piecewise function) is defined identically ('function which is defined by multiple sub-functions each over its own interval'). Class-to-class identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:PolynomialRing is the ring R[x] of polynomials over a base ring; wd:Q1455652 (polynomial ring) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:PosteriorDistribution is the distribution over a parameter after data, proportional to prior times likelihood; wd:Q278079 (posterior probability) is the posterior probability distribution used in Bayesian statistics. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:PriorDistribution is the distribution over a parameter before data, the input of a Bayesian update; wd:Q278090 (prior probability) is the prior probability distribution. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:ProbabilityMeasure is a measure of total mass one; wd:Q355020 (probability measure) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:ProbabilitySpace is the Kolmogorov triple (Ω, ℱ, P) made explicit; wd:Q623472 (probability space) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:QuadraticForm and wd:Q736753 name the same homogeneous degree-two form. GMEOW makes its carrier, scalar field, and shared metric signature explicit without changing the concept identity.
math:Quantity is the abstract dimensioned quantity (dimension + unit + magnitude); wd:Q107715 (physical quantity) is the close but not invertible physics counterpart. closeMatch.

math:Quotient is the general quotient of a structure by a compatible substructure; wd:Q1138961 (quotient group) is its canonical group instance. closeMatch, not identity: math:Quotient is broader (ring and module quotients too), so the map to the group-specific concept is a close but non-invertible counterpart.
math:RandomVariable is a measurable map from a sample space into a measurable codomain; wd:Q176623 (random variable) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:RiemannianManifold is a smooth manifold with a positive-definite metric; wd:Q632814 (Riemannian manifold) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:Ring is an abelian additive group with a distributive multiplication; wd:Q161172 (ring) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:RingHomomorphism preserves both ring operations; wd:Q1194212 (ring homomorphism) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:RootSystem is the finite root configuration of a semisimple Lie group; wd:Q534131 (root system) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:SampleSpace is the set of all possible outcomes Ω of a probabilistic experiment; wd:Q467440 (sample space) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:Semigroup is a magma with an associative operation; wd:Q207348 (semigroup) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:Sequence is an ordered indexed family (aₙ); wd:Q133250 (sequence) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:Series is an infinite sum ∑ aₙ; wd:Q170198 (series, 'infinite sum') is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:SigmaAlgebra is a collection of subsets closed under complement and countable union; wd:Q217357 (σ-algebra) is the same structure. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:SingularValueDecomposition is the A = U-Sigma-V* factorization; wd:Q420904 (singular value decomposition) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:SmoothManifold is a C^∞ manifold; wd:Q3552958 (differentiable manifold) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:Subspace is a vector subspace; wd:Q728435 (linear subspace) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:Surprisal is the self-information of an event, −log p(x); wd:Q735075 names that same logarithmic information content and lists surprisal as an alias. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:SymmetricMatrix is a square matrix equal to its transpose; wd:Q339011 (symmetric matrix) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:TangentSpace is the vector space of tangent vectors at a point; wd:Q909601 (tangent space) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch (curl-verified distinct from the tangent bundle).
math:TopologicalSpace is a space given by its open sets; wd:Q179899 (topological space) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:Vector is the coordinate vector (an element of a vector space in a basis); wd:Q44528 (Euclidean vector) is the geometric magnitude-and-direction reading. closeMatch: the coordinate vector and the geometric vector are close but not invertibly the same object.
math:VectorSpace is a module over a field; wd:Q125977 (vector space) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:WeylGroup is the reflection symmetry group of a root system; wd:Q768074 (Weyl group) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:ZigzagDiagram is the sequence whose structure maps may point forward or backward that zigzag persistence computes over; wd:Q59442785 (Zigzag Persistence) is the defining scholarly article (Carlsson–de Silva) introducing the construction. The object aligned to its defining reference, so skos:relatedMatch, not identity. QID verified via the Wikidata search API (instance-of scholarly article).
math:besselJ is the Bessel function of the first kind Jₙ; wd:Q219637 (Bessel function) is the whole family. closeMatch — the GMEOW individual is the first-kind member.

math:cellDimension carries a cell's grade n — the dimension of the cell; wd:Q4440864 (dimension, 'maximum number of independent directions within a mathematical space') is the general dimension concept. A specific-property-carrying-a-value vs the general concept is a generalization relation, not a near-identity, so skos:relatedMatch; QID verified via the Wikidata search API.

math:complexNumbers is the system ℂ; wd:Q11567 (complex number) names the number-type concept. closeMatch: the system individual and the number-type concept are close counterparts, not invertibly the same object.

math:convergesFinitely is the outcome of a limit that exists and is finite; wd:Q1211057 (convergent series, 'infinite series that produces a finite sum') is the nearest catalogued analysis concept — a convergent series is exactly one whose partial-sum sequence converges finitely — but it is series-specific rather than the general limit outcome, so skos:relatedMatch, not identity.

math:convexity is the analytic PROPERTY (a function lies on or below its chords), backed by math:convexityLaw; wd:Q319913 (convex function) is the function that bears it ('real function with secant line between points above the graph'). Property to function-class, close but not invertibly identical, so skos:closeMatch.

math:divergesToNegativeInfinity is the outcome of a limit running off to −∞, the dual of math:divergesToPositiveInfinity; wd:Q2592421 (divergence, 'lack of convergence of a series or integral') is the general non-convergence property it is one signed case of, a related resource rather than its identity, so skos:relatedMatch.

math:divergesToPositiveInfinity is the outcome of a limit running off to +∞; wd:Q2592421 (divergence, 'lack of convergence of a series or integral') is the general non-convergence property it is one signed case of, a related resource rather than its identity (Q2592421 does not distinguish the two poles), so skos:relatedMatch.
math:errorFunction is erf(x); wd:Q579262 (error function) is the same function. Identity, so skos:exactMatch (curl-verified distinct from loss function Q1036748).

math:eulerMascheroni is the exact constant γ; wd:Q273023 (Euler–Mascheroni constant) is the same constant — the limiting difference between the harmonic series and the natural logarithm. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:eulerNumber is the exact constant e; wd:Q82435 (Euler's number) is the same constant — the base of the natural logarithm. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:gammaFunction is Γ(z), the analytic continuation of the factorial; wd:Q190573 (gamma function) is the same function. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:integers is the system ℤ; wd:Q12503 (integer) names the number-type concept. closeMatch: the system individual and the number-type concept are close counterparts, not invertibly the same object.
math:learningWithErrors is the LWE hardness problem; wd:Q6510239 (learning with errors) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:naturalNumbers is the system ℕ; wd:Q21199 (natural number) names the number-type concept. closeMatch, not identity: the system individual and the (deliberately ambiguous — non-negative or positive) number-type concept are close counterparts, not invertibly the same object.
math:pi is the exact constant π; wd:Q167 (pi) is the same constant — the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:rationalNumbers is the system ℚ; wd:Q1244890 (rational number) names the number-type concept. closeMatch: the system individual and the number-type concept are close counterparts, not invertibly the same object.

math:realNumbers is the system ℝ; wd:Q12916 (real number) names the number-type concept. closeMatch: the system individual and the number-type concept are close counterparts, not invertibly the same object.
math:riemannZeta is ζ(s); wd:Q187235 (Riemann zeta function) is the same function. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:ringLearningWithErrors is the RLWE hardness problem; wd:Q25303820 (Ring Learning with Errors) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
